explanation.headline: Celecoxib is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 33.5 days on hand and Corvale General has 27.1 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows celecoxib is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 441 capsules of the 200 mg presentation with 13.2 used per day, giving 33.5 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 524 capsules of the 200 mg presentation with 19.3 used per day, giving 27.1 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Actavis Pharma, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
The second option is to buy from AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc., also not on FDA's shortage list today.
The third option is to buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., likewise not on FDA's shortage list today.
A label for celecoxib names Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC as a repack plant (FEI 3017450153) that received a VAI classification on 2024-09-06.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
